mood_contract: Unsettled competence: the synthesis is useful, but the student leaves asking whether it is right.

intended_learnings.text: Several agents coordinate through shared files: the filesystem is the meeting room.
Each source-finding agent speaks its own source's dialect; splitting by source keeps that.
Handoffs lose things: conflicts get papered over and a synthesizer averages to beige.
Split only when it earns its keep; one good agent with a good prompt often wins.
The synthesis is useful but unverified; the doubt about whether it is right stays open.
